title: General Relativity
description: Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

puzzle.goal: The curvature of spacetime, built from the metric g_μν and its derivatives (Ricci tensor and Ricci scalar), must be sourced by the energy and momentum of matter, T_μν, with a coupling fixed so that weak fields reproduce Newtonian gravity; a constant vacuum energy may also contribute in proportion to the metric. Write the source side of the field equations.
puzzle.name: Einstein field equations with cosmological constant
puzzle.form: 8 * π * G / c ^ 4 * T _ μν - Λ * g _ μν
puzzle.ask: The vacuum spherically symmetric solution has g_tt = −(1 − rs/r) with rs = 2GM/c². Find rs (m) for the Sun, M = 1.989e30 kg.
puzzle.method: Require the field equation to be a rank-2 tensor equation whose divergence vanishes (energy conservation) and whose weak-field limit is ∇²Φ = 4πGρ; this fixes the 8πG/c⁴ coupling.
